title: Move api.example.com to the new load balancer
description: DNS cutover with a scoped API token, a pre-cutover smoke test and a typed confirmation before the record changes.

steps.title: Create a scoped DNS API token
instructions: Sign in to the DNS provider dashboard with an account that can edit the example.com zone.
Profile -> API Tokens -> Create token -> template 'Edit zone DNS'.
Limit the token to the example.com zone and set it to expire in 7 days.
Copy the token once; the dashboard will not show it again.

steps.title: Lower the TTL on api.example.com to 60 seconds
instructions: Set TTL to 60 seconds and save. Leave the address unchanged.
Wait at least as long as the OLD TTL before the cutover step, so resolvers pick up the short TTL.

checks.description: public DNS now reports a TTL of 300 s or less

steps.title: Record the new load balancer address
instructions: Cloud console -> Load balancers -> api-prod-v2 -> Overview.
Copy the public IPv4 address (not the private one).

inputs.name: OLD_LB_IP
inputs.prompt: Current IPv4 address of api.example.com (for rollback)

steps.title: Smoke-test the new load balancer before any traffic moves
instructions: The check below calls /healthz on the new address while still sending the real hostname.
If it fails, fix the load balancer (certificate, target group health) and choose retry.

checks.description: new LB answers /healthz for api.example.com over TLS

steps.title: Point api.example.com at the new load balancer
steps.rollback: Set the A record back to the OLD_LB_IP saved in .env.cutover. With the 60 s TTL most clients return within 2 minutes; long-lived connections drain on their own.
instructions: Replace the address with the NEW_LB_IP value you entered earlier and save.
Do not change the TTL yet.

checks.description: public DNS returns the new address
production health check passes through DNS

steps.title: Close the change ticket
instructions: Add the old and new addresses and the cutover time to the change ticket.
Schedule a reminder to raise the TTL back to 3600 s after 24 quiet hours.
Revoke the DNS API token from step 1 once the TTL is raised.
